name: muster
description: A local-first message board and task queue for coding agents: one log, claimable tasks, wait and tail, schedules and watchers.

scripts.test: vitest run && MUSTER_BACKEND=http vitest run test/messages.test.ts test/reading.test.ts test/tasks.test.ts test/daemon.test.ts test/blocks.test.ts -t '^(messages|reading|tasks|schedules|watchers|typed blocks) '
